name: short
note: Hand-authored vector frames from synthetic fixtures. No screen capture, no real identifiers.

scenes.label: opening
scenes.caption: An AI agent that can draft a customer reply — and cannot send it.

scenes.label: case A · a request arrives
scenes.caption: A support request arrives. Ordinary, low risk, no money involved.

scenes.label: case A · the agent reads
scenes.caption: The agent reads one named message and looks up the order through a typed, read-only tool.

scenes.label: case A · evidence
scenes.caption: The reply is grounded in a record. No record, no claim — the run fails closed instead.

scenes.label: case A · the output
scenes.caption: A draft appears in the original thread, addressed to the person who wrote in. Nothing is sent.

scenes.label: case A · nothing changed
scenes.caption: Reading mutated nothing: same labels, still unread, zero sends.

scenes.label: case D · now it touches money
scenes.caption: Now a request that would move money.

scenes.label: case D · it stops
scenes.caption: The agent stops at awaiting_approval and writes no business row. It never had the permission to.

scenes.label: case D · a human decides
scenes.caption: A human decides, in a channel with no model in it.

scenes.label: the part most designs get wrong
scenes.caption: The approval is recorded — and business state is byte-identical. Approving is not executing.

scenes.label: a second, explicit act
scenes.caption: Execution is a separate, explicit command under a separate login.

scenes.label: one write, then a report
scenes.caption: One write. One outcome notification. Replaying the command changes nothing further.

scenes.label: close
scenes.caption: AI can reason. It cannot authorize itself, and it cannot write.
